verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Google Cloud runs a first-party managed Kubernetes service: GKE is named directly, users report Kubernetes clusters in the console, and `gcloud container clusters` commands appear in outage reports. No first-party documentation in the pack covers GKE itself, its upgrade policy, or its autoscaling. missing for 10: first-party GKE documentation, documented upgrade policy/release channels, documented cluster or node autoscaling, independent hands-on corroboration of upgrades and autoscaling.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, Kubernetes is managed — a first-party managed K8s service with documented upgrade policy and autoscaling

citations.quote: you don't have your Kubernetes clusters and CloudSQL databases
